# Title: Meeting on App Launch and Bug Resolution
# Today's meeting was to decide the launch date for the mobile app and review open bugs.

## Summary
The meeting agreed on launching the app on March 15th, with a condition that the login fix must be resolved by Friday before then. We also confirmed that Daniel will own the fix while Karen handles the other items.

## Key points
- The login bug is now fixed and can be released.
- Two days remain for testing the updated icons.
- Onboarding screens are ready for team review.
- The full regression suite is scheduled for Friday morning.

## Decisions
- Launch date: March 15
- Login fix: Daniel owns this, Karen owns the other items.
- Release notes and store screen shots: Prepared by the project manager.
- Open bugs: None recorded (all issues resolved).

## Action items
- [ ] I will own the login fix.
- [ ] Karen owns the icons and release notes.
- [ ] The project manager owns screenshots.
- [ ] Daniel is responsible for the full regression suite on Friday morning.
- [ ] Review board members sign off on the March 15 launch announcement at 3:00 PM.

## Open questions
- None recorded
